# DMR identification

```{r, eval=FALSE}
betas <- readRDS("/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/emseq_betas_healthy.rds")
betas_c <- readRDS("/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/emseq_betas_cancer.rds")
b <- rbind(betas %>% data.frame(), betas_c %>% data.frame())
b <- b %>% filter(seqnames == "chr1")
b$cov <- b$meth_count_pos + b$unmeth_count_pos
cols <- c("sample", "seqnames", "start", "meth_count_pos", "unmeth_count_pos", "cov")
b <- b[,cols] %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = c(meth_count_pos, unmeth_count_pos, cov))
b[is.na(b)] <- 0

samples <- c(unique(betas$sample), unique(betas_c$sample))
sample_stuff <- c(Type = c("healthy", "healthy", "healthy", "healthy", "healthy", "healthy", "cancer", "cancer", "cancer", "cancer", "cancer", "cancer")) %>% data.frame()
rownames(sample_stuff) <- samples

ranges <- b[,1:2]
meth <- b[,3:14]
colnames(meth) <- samples
cov <- b[,27:38]
colnames(cov) <- samples

#### bsseq
## make BSseq object
bseq <- bsseq::BSseq(M = as.matrix(meth),
                     Cov = as.matrix(cov), pData = sample_stuff,
                     chr = ranges$seqnames, pos = as.numeric(ranges$start),
                     sampleNames = samples)
bseq <- sort(bseq)
bseq <- bseq[which(rowSums(getCoverage(bseq) >= 10) == ncol(bseq)), ] 
param <- BiocParallel::SnowParam(workers = 8, type = "SOCK")
bs_batch1 <- BSmooth(bseq[, 1:6],  BPPARAM = param)
bs_batch2 <- BSmooth(bseq[, 7:12], BPPARAM = param)

# Combine afterwards
bsmooth_obj <- bsseq::combine(bs_batch1, bs_batch2)

#bsmooth_obj <- BSmooth(BSseq = bseq, verbose = TRUE)

bsmooth_obj <- bsmooth_obj[keep,]
saveRDS(bsmooth_obj, "/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/bsmooth_obj_emseq_chr1.rds")
```

```{r}
betas_for_wgbs <- function(reads) {
  # Split entire columns at once (vectorised, not row-wise)
  meth_split <- strsplit(reads$meth_pattern, "")
  pos_split  <- lapply(strsplit(reads$genom_positions, ","), as.double)
  n          <- lengths(meth_split)   # CpGs per read

  # Unnest with rep/unlist — much faster than tidyr::unnest
  dt <- data.table(
    sample      = rep(reads$sample,   n),
    seqnames    = rep(reads$seqnames, n),
    start       = unlist(pos_split,   use.names = FALSE),
    meth_status = unlist(meth_split,  use.names = FALSE)
  )

  # Count M/U and compute beta in one grouped pass
  result <- dt[, {
    m <- sum(meth_status == "M")
    u <- sum(meth_status == "U")
    list(meth_count_pos = m, unmeth_count_pos = u, beta = m / (m + u))
  }, keyby = .(sample, seqnames, start)]

  # Collapse across samples (matches original behaviour)
  unique(result[, .(sample, seqnames, start, meth_count_pos, unmeth_count_pos, beta)])
}
```
mmm

```{r}
library(DMRcate)
```

```{r}
design
```
```{r}
methdesign
```

```{r}
### dmrcate
tissue <- factor(c("male", "male", "female", "female", "female", "female", "female"), levels = c("male", "female"))

#Regular matrix design
design <- model.matrix(~tissue)
methdesign <- edgeR::modelMatrixMeth(design)

#failed here because no significance - good
seq_annot <- sequencing.annotate(bs_combined_, methdesign, all.cov = TRUE,
                                 coef = "tissuefemale", fdr=0.05)

seq_dmrcate.res <- dmrcate(seq_annot, C=2, min.cpgs = 5)

dmrcate_seq_dmr <- extractRanges(seq_dmrcate.res, genome = "hg38")
dmrcate_seq_dmr <- dmrcate_seq_dmr %>% data.frame()
dmrcate_seq_anno <- seq_annot@ranges %>% data.frame()

saveRDS(dmrcate_seq_dmr, "/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/dmr_emseq_healthy_sex.rds")
saveRDS(dmrcate_seq_anno, "/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/dm_emseq_healthy_sex.rds")
```

```{r}
dmrcate_seq_dmr %>% tail()
```
```{r}
dmrcate_seq_dmr %>% group_by(seqnames) %>% summarise(n=n())
```

```{r}
dmrcate_seq_dmr %>% mutate(seqnames = factor(seqnames, levels = seqs)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = seqnames, fill = seqnames)) +
    geom_bar() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
* so all dmrs were found on chromosome X
